summary: A low and a high value in one range, each with its own thumb.

min.description: The low end of the range.

max.description: The high end of the range.

step.description: The distance between two values the user can reach.

name.description: The name both values are submitted under, the low one first.

disabled.description: It cannot be changed or focused.

root.note: The hit area, with the track centred in it.

low.note: The thumb of the low value: a slider that cannot pass the high one.

high.note: The thumb of the high value: a slider that cannot pass the low one.

track.note: A recessed tray as tall as a thumb and fully rounded. The share between the two thumbs is solid.

fill.note: The share of the track up to the value, or between the two thumbs. The recipe may draw it as a second layer of the track.

keys.Arrow keys, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End: On a thumb: as on a slider, within what the other thumb allows.

events.input: Dispatched while the user changes a value.
events.change: Dispatched when the user has finished.

guidance.text: The author names the group with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Each thumb is named Minimum or Maximum unless the author writes the thumb and names it.
